title: School Notebooks 5-pack

adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 13.7. No event, promotion, or price change in target week. Recent weeks show strong back-to-school seasonality (Aug 3–24: sales 31–48), but that seasonality has already peaked and is declining (Aug 31: 14, Sep 7: 11). The baseline has captured this trend. Past promotions show high uplifts (x2.86 once), but no recent promotion and no evidence of a carryover effect. The classical model suggests no uplift, consistent with no driver. Noise-adjusted promotion lift is weak (x1.14), and no overlap with current week. No reason to adjust. Confidence is high due to clear seasonality decay and no active drivers.
